violation_type.title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety (26 TAC §744.1309(d))
violation_type.short_title: Documented Annual Training-Required Topics in Health and Safety
violation_type.typical_finding: One caregiver was missing the required annual training in the following topics: 1309(C),  1309 (D) (2), 1309 (D) (3), 1309 (D) (4).

finding_variants.text: One caregiver was missing the required annual training in the following topics: 1309(C),  1309 (D) (2), 1309 (D) (3), 1309 (D) (4).

The documented annual training hours/certificates provided for review for the caregiver did not include training on the following required topics in Health and Safety.  2. communicable diseases to  include immunizations 4. preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction 5. building and physical premises safety and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
Site director needs to complete allergy training, physical premises safety training, communicable disease training and handling, storing and disposal of hazardous materials training.

Neither of the two caregivers at the operation had acquired annual training in preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction or annual training in handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
One caregiver does not have the required training.

The operation has not provided proof of certificates for annual trainings that were originally due during the 08/19/2025 monitoring inspection. Neither of the two caregivers at the operation had acquired annual training in preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction or annual training in handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.
